parsed.explanation: Parent-regime framework is strongly protective on paper: no criminalisation, gender-identity discrimination ban since 2012, transphobia an aggravator for all imprisonable crimes since 2017, conversion-therapy ban, marriage equality, and marker change without surgery. None of these is a direct visitor protection, but together they signal trans-respecting institutions. Deductions: a documented, unremedied state-imposed exposure — trans women held in all-male facilities by recorded legal sex, with the national preventive mechanism finding persistent serious violations (~40 referrals since 2010, one 2014 transfer) and no remedy; low frequency, thin local record, and oversight findings are corroboration, not mitigation. Access to gender-affirming care is uneven and no local specialist care exists. Social stigma, concealment and religious norms are friction, not documented hostility. Border practice, local hate-crime enforcement and service discrimination are undocumented — open questions, not exposures. Below acceptance-with-working-protections tiers, above the unremedied-universal-exposure band.
